bundleIdentity: served index.html bundle == bundle the loaded page executes == local dist-dev build
boardSeed: interactive-app-review s6, interactive-holdouts s2; a stale prior-seed blob written into storage and verified ignored; unknown board name shows the visible notice
pass: 5 - raise the interaction quality bar: every interaction must reveal a relationship, counterfactual, or consequence a static picture could not
interactionsPerformedOnDeployedPage: I01 attention: query picker changes the whole pipeline; mask toggle blanks/fills the future scores and reshapes the distribution and output
I02 image-patch: grid click + stepper move the enlarged crop window onto the same file

I03 world-model: the Action changes the actual predicted rollout (t+1/t+2/outcome) and its cost readout; the Goal (Safest/Fastest) re-weights the costs so the ringed preferred action flips (Safest->Brake, Fastest->Continue) with the futures unchanged
I04 vector projection: typed coordinates + pointer drag recompute the projection live
selection pill + bottom composer is the one ask surface; the request payload carried the visible experiment state

counterfactualPerCard.I01: toggle the causal mask -> future-position scores blank, the softmax redistributes over the visible keys, the output vector changes
counterfactualPerCard.I02: step the patch index -> the enlarged crop is a different window onto the same image (inspection, not a highlight)
counterfactualPerCard.I03: change the objective with the SAME three predicted futures -> the planner's lowest-cost action changes (Brake vs Continue); change the action -> the predicted trajectory itself changes
counterfactualPerCard.I04: drag b or type a -> proj_b(a), its endpoint and a.b recompute; set a orthogonal to b -> the projection collapses to zero

declutter.attention: one dominant left-to-right pipeline (query token -> Q[query] -> scores QK^T/sqrt(dk) -> attention weights (sum to 1) -> output). The duplicated full Q/K/V matrices and the full 4x4 score matrix were removed; the tokens in the visual are labels that highlight the query, not a second query toolbar (the one query control is the INTERACT picker below).

practice: removed from all four cards - they are explore-only. The generic Explore/Practice activity layer still exists in the runtime and keeps its own unit tests, but no card on this board attaches a task.
knownLimitsAtHandoff: Tutor ANSWERS on this clone return the designed no-credential error (model HTTP 401) - true wrangler secrets do not clone; the request path and payload were verified; full answers require the shared worker after explicit promotion
The widest card (I01) can extend under the floating drawing toolbar at narrow viewports; cards are movable and the canvas pans
No external interaction reference captured; temporal smoothness beyond intermediate-value traces unassessed

interactionGrammar.rule: inside the visual = understand/inspect; a labeled INTERACT zone below the visual+transport = manipulate; PRACTICE only when a task exists (none here); bottom chat = ask
interactionGrammar.implementation: the card shell renders the INTERACT zone generically from the declared non-hidden inputs (every input gets an obvious control there); direct on-scene manipulation (clicked patch, dragged vec2) remains a synchronized shortcut writing the SAME input; transport (replay/timeline) stays a separate row; no scene-ID branch, no per-lesson placement in runtime code; the world-model card was authored with existing input types (two index inputs) and existing derive ops (pick/scale/add/argmin) - no new primitive
interactionGrammar.verifiedCards: i01/i02/i03/i04 at 1:1 capture in both themes
